## Appearance

Priscilla Grant is a pale and spiritual-looking young woman who possesses an ethereal, golden beauty. She is also described as looking fair when dressed in silk attire.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 XX The Way It Often Happens P22](../source/v02-c20.md#nw-v02-c20-p0022), [v4 CHAPTER 1 IN THE GARRET OF GREEN GABLES P24](../source/v04-c01.md#nw-v04-c01-p0024)_

## Personality

Priscilla Grant is an imaginative and ambitious student. Despite presenting a pale, spiritual-looking appearance, she is secretly full to the brim of mischief, pranks, and fun.

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004)_

## History

Priscilla Grant attended Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy) with her close friend [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md). Following her schooling, she was hired to teach at [Carmody](../codex/places.md#carmody) school. Later, she served as a conduit for famous author Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md)—who was Priscilla's aunt—arranging visits and bringing Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) to [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables) to meet [Anne](../character/anne.md). When Priscilla matriculated at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport), she warmly greeted [Anne](../character/anne.md) at the train station and helped her adjust to university life. While strolling through Old St. John's Cemetery, Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne.md) befriended fellow student [Philippa Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md). Seeking a new residence for their upcoming school year, Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne.md) discovered that Patty's Place was available for rent and successfully secured the home alongside [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) and [Aunt Jamesina](../character/aunt-jamesina.md). Over the course of their college years, Priscilla shared in the lively home life at Patty's Place, hosted summer visits in [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), and ultimately completed her studies at [Redmond](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) through [Convocation](../codex/places.md#convocation).

_Sources: [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P44](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0044), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P46](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0046), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P47](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0047), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P49](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0049), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P51](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0051), [v1 CHAPTER XV. A Tempest in the School Teapot P53](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0053), +612 more_

## Quotes

> "I’m so sorry, but I’m afraid we won’t get up to Green Gables at all now, for by the time Aunty’s ankle is well she will have to go back to Toronto. She has to be there by a certain date."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> “And oh, Anne dear,” wrote Priscilla, “I’m so sorry, but I’m afraid we won’t get up to Green Gables at all now, for by the time Aunty’s ankle is well she will have to go back to Toronto. She has to be there by a certain date.”
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v2 XVII A Chapter of Accidents P63](../source/v02-c17.md#nw-v02-c17-p0063)

> "She talks as much about boys as Ruby Gillis does. But it always enrages or sickens me to hear Ruby, whereas I just wanted to laugh good-naturedly at Phil. Now, what is the why of that?"
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Lady P70](../source/v03-c04.md#nw-v03-c04-p0070)

> "It would be too good to be true. Fairy tales don’t happen nowadays. I won’t hope, Anne. The disappointment would be too awful to bear. They’re sure to want more for it than we can afford. Remember, it’s on Spofford Avenue."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Friend P31](../source/v03-c09.md#nw-v03-c09-p0031)

> "This cake is now what you might call a flat failure. And the cushion is likewise ruined. Never tell me that Friday isn’t unlucky."
>
> — Priscilla Grant — [v3 ch.Gardners’Call P35](../source/v03-c36.md#nw-v03-c36-p0035)

## Relationships

### [Anne](../character/anne.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne](../character/anne.md) enjoy an intimate friendship, spending leisure time together wandering through the woods, exploring old gardens, and sharing picnics. They share a romantic appreciation for nature and poetry during their group outings.

- Friend of — intimate friends  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P57](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0057), [v2 XIII A Golden Picnic P3](../source/v02-c13.md#nw-v02-c13-p0003), +12 more</sub>

### [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/anne-shirley--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Anne Shirley](../character/anne-shirley.md) are intimate friends who first formed a close bond as fellow students at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). Their friendship continues into adulthood as Priscilla takes a teaching job near [Avonlea](../codex/places.md#avonlea), visits [Anne](../character/anne.md) at [Green Gables](../codex/places.md#green-gables), and warmly greets her upon her arrival at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) to help her get settled in [Kingsport](../codex/places.md#kingsport).

- Friend of — intimate friends and fellow students at Queen's Academy  <sub>[v1 CHAPTER XXXV. The Winter at Queen’s P4](../source/v01-c35.md#nw-v01-c35-p0004), [v2 I An Irate Neighbor P58](../source/v02-c01.md#nw-v02-c01-p0058), [v2 VI All Sorts and Conditions of Men . . . and women P5](../source/v02-c06.md#nw-v02-c06-p0005), +3 more</sub>

### [Stella Maynard](../character/stella-maynard.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/priscilla-grant--stella-maynard.md)

[Stella](../character/stella-maynard.md) and Priscilla belong to a close circle of friends that formed during their time at Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy). ### [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/morgan--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla is the niece of author Mrs. Charlotte E. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md). She acts as a host and companion to her aunt, accompanying Mrs. [Morgan](../character/morgan.md) and Mrs. [Pendexter](../character/pendexter.md) on visits to see [Anne](../character/anne.md).

### [Phil Gordon](../character/phil-gordon.md) · [the relationship](../relationships/phil-gordon--priscilla-grant.md)

Priscilla and [Phil](../character/phil-gordon.md) become fast friends after meeting on their first day at [Redmond College](../codex/places.md#redmond-college) while sitting on a gravestone in Old St. John's Cemetery. They spend their time walking through local parks, navigating college social circles together, and agreeing to share a home at Patty's Place.
